title: Upower
description: The upower module displays the main battery capacity with all other upower compatible devices in the tooltip.

placeholders.description: An estimated time either until empty or until fully charged depending on the charging state.
The battery temperature in degrees Celsius.
The model name of the device.

native-path.label: Native path
native-path.doc: The battery to monitor. Refer to the https://upower.freedesktop.org/docs/UpDevice.html#UpDevice--native-path Can be obtained using upower --dump
native-path.description: The battery to monitor. Refer to the https://upower.freedesktop.org/docs/UpDevice.html#UpDevice--native-path Can be obtained using upower --dump

model.label: Model
model.doc: The battery to monitor, based on the model. (this option is ignored if native-path is given). Can be obtained using upower --dump
model.description: The battery to monitor, based on the model. (this option is ignored if native-path is given). Can be obtained using upower --dump

icon-size.label: Icon size
icon-size.doc: Defines the size of the icons. Set to 0 for automatic sizing.
icon-size.description: Defines the size of the icons. Set to 0 for automatic sizing.

format.label: What to show
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-alt.label: What to show after a click
format-alt.description: Clicking the module switches to this text. Click again to go back.

hide-if-empty.label: Hide if empty
hide-if-empty.doc: Defines visibility of the module if no devices can be found.
hide-if-empty.description: Defines visibility of the module if no devices can be found.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-spacing.label: Tooltip spacing
tooltip-spacing.doc: Defines the spacing between the tooltip device name and device battery status.
tooltip-spacing.description: Defines the spacing between the tooltip device name and device battery status.

tooltip-padding.label: Tooltip padding
tooltip-padding.doc: Defines the spacing between the tooltip window edge and the tooltip content.
tooltip-padding.description: Defines the spacing between the tooltip window edge and the tooltip content.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The format used for each device line shown in the tooltip. Accepts the same replacements as format.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when clicked on the module.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.
